evaluation.clock_contract: Original seven-day historical availability assumption and frozen query cutoffs preserved; not authenticated historical publication timing or genuine pregame issuance
evaluation.cohort: Frozen query position retained even when raw source position differs; all original 2999 queries retained, nonprimary coverage reported separately

ordering: generate all four procedures on all 2999 queries
freeze model, training/query projections and all forecasts in managed private storage with exact readback
project and qualify actual target outcomes
score unchanged forecast values and freeze grades
retain success or complete failure receipt; no automatic retry
execution.publication_gate: Exact portable code, this science record and protocol published with immutable remote readback proof before root seals execution; exact source independent review also required

hypothesis: A fixed strong reception-feature leaf-CDF fitted to qualified target outcomes may reduce target point-display MAE relative to an unchanged earlier-history recent-eight-target mean on identical frozen 2026 cases.

labels.known_limit: Exact retained historical aggregation commit and nullified/two-point target-credit exceptions not fully verified. Current public code uses stat_id115; contextual source inspection does not authenticate retained builder lineage.
labels.participation: Positive finite official physical count or nonzero finite signed production. Explicit source targets=0 plus positive other physical event qualifies played-zero. Missing source and zero-only rows stay unknown; no DNP imputation.
labels.raw_identity: Six source rows missing canonical player identity quarantined using metadata before target/action projection, originals retained; never assigned fabricated players or used as zero labels.

method_counting: Four recorded procedures, three families, one tree fit. Recent3/8 are two fixed settings in one recent-history family; one CDF mean and median are distinct outputs of one model.
new_mechanism: First separately identified direct target CDF using the unchanged existing reception-CDF representation. No new role information or learner tuning. Prior auxiliary target-count work is retained separately, not represented as a reproduced complete benchmark.

prespecified_primary.comparison: same player-game and frozen horizon; point-display comparison, not equal-functional or probability superiority
prespecified_primary.population: frozen query RB/WR/TE roles with qualified played target labels

prior_work: QL1 label-empty query finding, QL2 failed raw identity attempt, identity-only diagnostic, QL3 successful source qualification, fictional/source checks and source-GET failures remain separately recorded; zero previous target predictive fits are attributed to these preparation runs.

procedures.fallback: Existing cold/unsupported-role training position prior or global prior; abstain if no supported training outcomes

procedures.fit_accounting: Same CDF training priors; zero additional tree fits
procedures.formula: Geometric count prior on nonnegative integers: p = 1/(1+max(training position mean,0.05)), P(Y=k)=p*(1-p)^k; unknown role uses training global prior
f_player_targets_mean3 when finite nonnegative with finite n3>0, else the same training-position prior mean; unknown role global prior; abstain without prior
f_player_targets_mean8 when finite nonnegative with finite n8>0, else the same training-position prior mean; unknown role global prior; abstain without prior

dependencies: retained production-owner admission/capture/publication and served-value readback

restoration: Restricted source snapshots, row forecasts, fitted model, labels and private storage bindings remain in existing approved owner-controlled private restoration route, manifest keyed by this run. The public record contains no storage destination; hash or public report alone is not proof of off-host restoration.

scoring.calibration: NOT_ESTABLISHED for target offered thresholds; no fabricated target lines
scoring.coverage: Full planned/forecasted/scored/fallback/unknown counts; primary and all-role panels separate; preserve every unsupported row
scoring.distribution_primary: CRPS for supported complete CDF/prior laws; secondary log loss retains positive infinity and exact denominator
scoring.exact_count: Only registered integer lower count median; means not rounded
scoring.periods: 2026 each supported week and pooled W1-6; no new 2025 evaluation in this frozen pilot

uncertainty.note: Six supported weeks cannot supply an admitted week bootstrap interval; report null with reason. Game interval is development diagnostic, not selection-adjusted universal guarantee.

training.admission: schedule-authenticated regular-season rows; kickoff and recorded outcome availability strictly before cutoff; valid nonnegative integer target and qualified played state
training.feature_memory: Existing features may include 2019-2021 warm history; not strict current-season information
training.history_comparison_status: NOT weekly H-MULTI and NOT completion of H-CURRENT/H-RECENT/H-MULTI comparison
training.name: REC_TGT_FROZEN_PRESEASON_2022_2025
training.preprocessing: Fit missing-value medians, missing flags and position one-hot representation only on modeled training rows. No tuning/calibration/stacking.
training.refit_rule: one fit before 2026; no within-2026 updates

unsupported.market_offer_probability_or_EV: No authenticated target offers, prices, settlement or frozen selections
